executed.statement:
select (hist = 0 and softdel = 0 and deltrig = 0) as no_trail,
                 'history/versioning/audit relations naming ' || 'hand_records' || ': ' || hist::text ||
                 ', soft-delete columns: ' || softdel::text ||
                 ', delete triggers that write a record: ' || deltrig::text ||
                 ' (delete triggers that only guard or refuse, not a trail: ' || delguard::text || ')' as detail
          from (select
                  (select count(*) from pg_class c
                    where c.relkind in ('r','p')
                      and c.relnamespace::regnamespace::text in ('public','private')
                      and (c.relname like '%' || 'hand_records' || '%history%'
                        or c.relname like '%' || 'hand_records' || '%audit%'
                        or c.relname like '%' || 'hand_records' || '%version%'
                        or c.relname like '%' || 'hand_records' || '_log')) hist,
                  (select count(*) from pg_attribute a
                    where a.attrelid = 'public.hand_records'::regclass and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
                      and a.attname in ('deleted_at','removed_at','archived_at','is_deleted')) softdel,
                  (select count(*) from pg_trigger tg join pg_proc fp on fp.oid = tg.tgfoid
                    where tg.tgrelid = 'public.hand_records'::regclass and not tg.tgisinternal
                      and (tg.tgtype & 8) <> 0 and fp.prosrc ~* 'insert\s+into') deltrig,
                  (select count(*) from pg_trigger tg join pg_proc fp on fp.oid = tg.tgfoid
                    where tg.tgrelid = 'public.hand_records'::regclass and not tg.tgisinternal
                      and (tg.tgtype & 8) <> 0 and fp.prosrc !~* 'insert\s+into') delguard
               ) x

executed.statement:
select (hist = 0 and softdel = 0 and deltrig = 0) as no_trail,
                 'history/versioning/audit relations naming ' || 'profiles' || ': ' || hist::text ||
                 ', soft-delete columns: ' || softdel::text ||
                 ', delete triggers that write a record: ' || deltrig::text ||
                 ' (delete triggers that only guard or refuse, not a trail: ' || delguard::text || ')' as detail
          from (select
                  (select count(*) from pg_class c
                    where c.relkind in ('r','p')
                      and c.relnamespace::regnamespace::text in ('public','private')
                      and (c.relname like '%' || 'profiles' || '%history%'
                        or c.relname like '%' || 'profiles' || '%audit%'
                        or c.relname like '%' || 'profiles' || '%version%'
                        or c.relname like '%' || 'profiles' || '_log')) hist,
                  (select count(*) from pg_attribute a
                    where a.attrelid = 'public.profiles'::regclass and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped
                      and a.attname in ('deleted_at','removed_at','archived_at','is_deleted')) softdel,
                  (select count(*) from pg_trigger tg join pg_proc fp on fp.oid = tg.tgfoid
                    where tg.tgrelid = 'public.profiles'::regclass and not tg.tgisinternal
                      and (tg.tgtype & 8) <> 0 and fp.prosrc ~* 'insert\s+into') deltrig,
                  (select count(*) from pg_trigger tg join pg_proc fp on fp.oid = tg.tgfoid
                    where tg.tgrelid = 'public.profiles'::regclass and not tg.tgisinternal
                      and (tg.tgtype & 8) <> 0 and fp.prosrc !~* 'insert\s+into') delguard

          from (select

                 'history/versioning/audit relations naming ' || 'wallets' || ': ' || hist::text ||

          from (select

                      and c.relnamespace::regnamespace::text in ('public','private')
                      and (c.relname like '%' || 'wallets' || '%history%'

                        or c.relname like '%' || 'wallets' || '%version%'

                    where tg.tgrelid = 'public.wallets'::regclass and not tg.tgisinternal
                      and (tg.tgtype & 8) <> 0 and fp.prosrc ~* 'insert\s+into') deltrig,
